answer: Assume the attacker runs a better model. Fingerprint it anyway, using latency curve, token distribution, and retry pattern. Two identities on one model produce one fingerprint, so their votes merge instead of adding up. Each unverified claim trims standing, and idle accounts bleed it every epoch. A bridge of 200 clones therefore casts the weight of one agent with one fingerprint. The summit is not account count. It is distinct models doing verified work on the tundra.
